identity.name: Forgeit Design System
identity.archetype: The Performance Pro x Swiss High-Contrast
identity.vibe: Smart City, Digital Infrastructure, Youthful Professionalism
principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix 'Smart City' tech aesthetics with 'Community' warmth.
Emotion First: Every interaction should feel like a 'connection' being made.
Content is King: Data and profiles are the heroes; UI is the stage.
Zoom In: Focus on faces and connections.
Negative Space: Use whitespace to create a 'premium' feel.

typography.installation: Import fonts via Google Fonts in index.css: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&family=Manrope:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap');

primary.name: Electric Indigo
primary.description: Vibrant, youthful, yet professional. Used for primary actions and brand moments.

accent.name: Connection Teal
accent.description: Used for success states, active connections, and highlights.

background.description: Clean white for light mode, deep void blue for dark mode (not pure black).

grid_system.marketing: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8 (The Tetris Grid)

header.style: fixed top-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 border-b border-border/40

cards.style: group relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-card text-card-foreground shadow-sm transition-all hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/50

buttons.primary: rounded-full bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-lg shadow-primary/20
buttons.secondary: rounded-full border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground

inputs.style: rounded-lg border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

hero.alt: Diverse students collaborating on a project

motion.scroll: Use 'lenis' for smooth scrolling. Add 'scroll-smooth' to html tag as fallback.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA standards. Use 'text-foreground' on 'bg-background'.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic 'Bootstrap' layouts. Use asymmetry and negative space.
Dark mode is mandatory. Ensure all colors have dark mode equivalents.
Do not use 'transparent' backgrounds for dropdowns or overlays; use glassmorphism.
Images must be used from the provided list. Do not use placeholders.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building 'Forgeit', a smart-city themed networking platform. Use the provided colors, fonts, and images. Implement the 'Tetris Grid' for the landing page and 'High Density Grid' for the dashboard. Ensure the header is translucent and sticky. Use Shadcn UI components but customize them with the 'rounded-xl' and 'glassmorphism' styles defined here.
